title: Include declaring-project uses in F# consumer-position reference counts
outcome: F# references positioned in a consumer include non-definition uses from the distinct declaring project and all proven dependents without double counting.
acceptance: A public regression with one declaring-project use and one consumer use reports the same complete total from declaration and consumer positions.

completion.summary: Consumer-position F# reference queries now scan a distinct declaring project once and deduplicate physical sites across every context.
